title: LethalDefense
description: Fancy defense methods, for your protecting needs.
body:
## ❔
### What is this mod?
This mod is a new minecraft mod that can fulfill your protecting needs!
This mods features for example:
**>Leaf Trap**
> 
Leaf traps are camouflaged traps, that makes it so when a mob/someone walks on it, it destroys itself, and makes the entity fall down.

**> Spike**
> 
Spikes are... Spikes?
The spikes deal more damage, as the person falls from further.

**> Mine**
> 
Mines explode when someone walks on it.
